page_title: BEL 1-0 CAN | Belgium v Canada 23/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:21.
90+3' Belgium are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
90+1' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) gets inside the box and tries to beat Milan Borjan with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
90+1' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) works the corner short.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' A cross from a corner kick by Canada is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90' Sam Adekugbe (Canada) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Canada will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
89' Liam Millar (Canada) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
86' Cyle Larin (Canada) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
86' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
85' Lois Openda (Belgium) is able to continue to play.
85' Kevin De Bruyne sends the free kick into the box. Leander Dendoncker (Belgium) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it high over the bar.
84' The game is interrupted now, Lois Openda (Belgium) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
83' Alistair Johnston (Canada) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
81' Alphonso Davies (Canada) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
81' Substitution. Stephen Eustaquio will be replaced by Jonathan Osorio (Canada).
81' John Herdman has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Liam Millar (Canada) replacing Tajon Buchanan.
80' Cyle Larin (Canada) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Thibaut Courtois is prepared and dives to thwart him.
79' The attendance is 40432.
78' Roberto Martinez has decided to make a change. Lois Openda (Belgium) replaces Michy Batshuayi.
77' Jonathan David (Canada) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
76' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) sends a short pass into the box, Cyle Larin takes a touch to control the ball, but one of the defenders robs him of it and clears to safety.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Richie Laryea trots off the pitch and is replaced by Sam Adekugbe (Canada).
73' The ball is cleared after Leandro Trossard (Belgium) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
72' Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) commits a foul and Janny Sikazwe immediately signals a free kick.
71' 5:18 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
68' Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
68' Corner kick. Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) is ready to send the ball into the box.

67' Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
66' Richie Laryea (Canada) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
64' There's an opportunity for Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
64' Thomas Meunier (Belgium) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
63' That's a well-taken pass by Tajon Buchanan (Canada). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
62' The substitution has been made. Leandro Trossard (Belgium) has replaced Eden Hazard.
61' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
60' Thomas Meunier (Belgium) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
58' John Herdman decides to make a substitution. Atiba Hutchinson will be replaced by Ismael Kone (Canada).
58' It's time for a substitution. Cyle Larin (Canada) comes on in place of Junior Hoilett.
56' Janny Sikazwe shows a yellow card to Amadou Onana (Belgium) for his blatant foul.
56' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Tajon Buchanan (Canada) but poses no threat.
55' Alphonso Davies (Canada) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
55' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thomas Meunier (Belgium) was quite harsh and Janny Sikazwe didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' Amadou Onana (Belgium) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Michy Batshuayi, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
50' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
48' Stephen Eustaquio looks up and plays a clever lofted ball onto the head of Jonathan David (Canada), who sends the ball narrowly wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
48' Janny Sikazwe blows for a foul after Amadou Onana (Belgium) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
47' Axel Witsel (Belgium) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
46' Half-time substitution. Roberto Martinez decided to make a change. Yannick Carrasco is replaced by Thomas Meunier (Belgium).
46' Half-time substitution. Youri Tielemans is replaced by Amadou Onana (Belgium).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Janny Sikazwe blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45+4' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Canada.
45+2' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

44' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Toby Alderweireld, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Michy Batshuayi (Belgium), who beats Milan Borjan with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 1:0.
41' Atiba Hutchinson (Canada) commits a rough challenge and Janny Sikazwe blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Referee Janny Sikazwe signals NO PENALTY for Canada after a VAR review!
39' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Canada! Let's see what he decides.
38' Richie Laryea (Canada) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
37' Alistair Johnston (Canada) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
34' 2:11 – the total goal attempt statistics.
33' Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
33' Jonathan David (Canada) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
31' Jonathan David (Canada) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

30' Alistair Johnston (Canada) gets inside the box and tries to beat Thibaut Courtois with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
29' Richie Laryea (Canada) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
27' Atiba Hutchinson (Canada) receives a pass from Alphonso Davies and attempts to score from the edge of the box, but the shot slips well wide of the right post.
26' Alistair Johnston (Canada) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Janny Sikazwe blows his whistle for a foul.
24' The corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) is intercepted by the defence.
23' Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
23' Richie Laryea (Canada) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
22' Poor challenge! Atiba Hutchinson (Canada) is penalised for tripping and Janny Sikazwe blows his whistle.
20' Janny Sikazwe blows his whistle and signals a foul after Tajon Buchanan (Canada) brought his opponent down.
17' Alistair Johnston (Canada) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Janny Sikazwe blows his whistle for an infringement.
16' Junior Hoilett (Canada) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post.
14' The linesman raises his flag. Tajon Buchanan (Canada) is adjudged offside.
13' Jonathan David (Canada) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
13' A wild effort from Richie Laryea (Canada) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
11' Jonathan David (Canada) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
11' Alphonso Davies (Canada) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Thibaut Courtois leaps out to thwart his attempt.
10' Alphonso Davies (Canada) is going to take the penalty!
9' That's a clear yellow card. Yannick Carrasco (Belgium) goes into the book.
9' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Canada!

8' Play continues despite the shouts by some Canada players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Janny Sikazwe interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
8' Yannick Carrasco (Belgium) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
8' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Tajon Buchanan (Canada) inside the box.
7' Canada have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) commits a rough foul. Janny Sikazwe stops the game and makes a call.
3' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) brings his opponent down. Janny Sikazwe has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Wow, what an escape. Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
2' Junior Hoilett (Canada) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
1' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) causes Milan Borjan little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Canada will take the kick-off.
Janny Sikazwe was nominated as the referee for this game.
